title: CrisiLangs: A Multilingual Resource for Crisis Warning Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Communicating with the public during an emergency entails issuing warning messages promptly. In Europe, it often requires producing them in more than one language. Recent work has shown that language models can be trained to generate warning messages as a crisis unfolds, but the available data covers only English. To fill this gap, we present CrisiLangs, a multilingual extension of CrisiText (an English dataset of crisis events paired with warning messages written according to expert communication guidelines) to Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek. Expert native speakers translated the warning messages of 1,000 events drawn from 411 scenarios, for a total of 5,000 event-message pairs across five languages. We test the resource to fine-tune a multilingual model on all five languages jointly, with and without the emergency guidelines in the prompt, and compare it with a zero-shot baseline. translated_title: CrisiLangs：用于危机预警生成的多语言资源
translated_abstract: 在紧急情况下与公众沟通需要及时发布警告信息。在欧洲，这通常需要以多种语言制作这些信息。近期研究表明，可以训练语言模型在危机发生时生成警告信息，但现有数据仅涵盖英语。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CrisiLangs，这是CrisiText（一个将危机事件与根据专家沟通指南编写的警告信息相配对的英语数据集）的多语言扩展版本，涵盖意大利语、保加利亚语、德语和希腊语。母语专家翻译了来自411个场景中1,000个事件的警告信息，五种语言总计5,000个事件-信息对。我们测试了利用该资源在全部五种语言上联合微调多语言模型的效果，分别在提示中包含与不包含应急指南两种情况下进行，并与零样本基线进行比较。微调后的模型表现优于基线。
tldr: 该论文提出了CrisiLangs——将英语危机警告数据集CrisiText扩展至意大利语、保加利亚语、德语和希腊语的多语言资源，包含五种语言共5,000个事件-警告信息对，可用于微调多语言模型以在危机期间生成多语言警告信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CrisiLangs, a multilingual extension of the English crisis warning dataset CrisiText to Italian, Bulgarian, German, and Greek, comprising 5,000 event-warning message pairs across five languages for fine-tuning multilingual models to generate crisis warnings.
